Goa Housing Board, Porvorim is inviting applications for the post of Junior Engineer (Civil).

📌 Position: Junior Engineer (Civil)
📍 Location: Porvorim, Goa
🔢 No. of Posts: 01
📋 Category: OBC
💼 Pay Scale: Level 5
🎓 Qualification: Degree or Diploma in Civil Engineering from a recognised University, State Board or equivalent
🗣️ Knowledge of Konkani required; Marathi is desirable
📄 Candidates must submit the prescribed application along with the required self-attested documents.

📅 Last Date to Apply: 21 October 2026

Save this post and share it with eligible candidates who may be interested.

Goa Dental College & Hospital is conducting a Walk-In Interview for the post of Staff Nurse.

📍 Location: Cujira, Santa Cruz, Tiswadi, Goa
💼 Position: Staff Nurse
📝 Job Type: Contract Basis
🎓 Qualification: Certificate in Nursing / B.Sc Nursing with required registration
🎂 Age Limit: Not exceeding 45 years
💰 Remuneration: ₹47,500 per month
🗓️ Walk-In Interview: 08 October 2026 at 10:30 a.m.
📌 Document verification: 9:30 a.m. to 10:15 a.m.

Candidates should carry the required original documents, certificates and photocopies for verification.
